heading: Hi — I'm Soukeyna.
intro: I'm the travel advisor behind Voyage By Luna. Not a call center, not a booking portal — when you send an enquiry through this site, I'm the person who reads it and replies.
body:
I plan cruises, all-inclusive resorts, Disney and theme park trips, and destination weddings and honeymoons. Hello! If you are new to my page, I'm Soukeyna, a Travel Advisor and proud mom of three. For the past two years, I’ve built a business that allows me to combine my love for travel with helping others experience the world. Not only do I create dream vacations for my clients, but I also get to explore the world with my own family, saving money and making memories along the way.

Whether you're dreaming of a relaxing family getaway or a thrilling adventure, I’m here to design personalized travel experiences tailored to your needs. My passion for travel and commitment to excellence drives me to continuously innovate and improve the services I offer. I work closely with trusted partners around the globe to bring you exclusive deals and one-of-a-kind experiences you won’t find anywhere else. Your satisfaction is my top priority, and I’m here to guide you every step of the way, from the initial planning stages to your safe return home.

What truly sets me apart is my dedication to empowering others to turn their love for travel into a rewarding career. I’ve helped many aspiring travel agents launch their businesses, sharing my knowledge and expertise to guide them to success.

With your support, I can continue to expand my impact—making travel dreams come true for families, solo travelers, and aspiring travel professionals alike. Let’s collaborate to create incredible journeys and inspire future explorers!

Reach out today to start your next adventure!

Soukeyna Traore-Dia
Certified, Licensed & Bonded Travel Advisor
(424) 279-0200
Voyagebyluna.com 
Voyage By Luna
body_two: I also write the Voyage By Luna travel blog — guides to Japan, Korea, Bali, Seychelles, Bora Bora, Portugal, the Philippines and more, plus theme park trips I've taken with my own kids. It's the easiest way to get a sense of how I think about a destination before you ever contact me.
expect_heading: What to expect working with me

expect_points.title: A real reply, from me
expect_points.body: Not an autoresponder and not a quote generator. I read what you sent and answer the actual question.

expect_points.title: Options with the trade-offs spelled out
expect_points.body: Cheaper isn't always better and neither is pricier. I'll tell you what you're giving up either way.

expect_points.title: No pressure to book
expect_points.body: Plenty of first conversations don't turn into trips, and that's genuinely fine.
